reply.text: Mostly nay right after lifting, if size and strength are what you're after. Research suggests that cold water immersion within a few hours of a lifting session can blunt some of the muscle-building signal, so you'd be trading away a bit of the adaptation you just trained for. It's useful when you need to feel fresh quickly, like between games or a two-a-day, or if you simply enjoy it. In that case, put it a few hours after training or on a rest day. If you have a heart condition or any other medical concern, check with a doctor before you start plunging. Sleep, food, and a good warm-up will do more for your recovery than the tub will.
